question.text: In a group of 14 males and 6 females. 8 and 3 of the males and females, respectively are aged above 40 yr. The probability that a selected at random from the group is person aged above $40 \mathrm{yr}$ given that the selected person is a female, is

solution.text:
Number of males = 14
and females $=6$
Total =14+6=20
Males above $40 \mathrm{yr}=8$ 
and females above $40 \mathrm{y}=3$
Now, P (selected person is female and above 40 yn) $=\frac{3}{6}=\frac{1}{2}$
